Source/dev is excluded here, so out/Source/dev never exists and the guarded require in extension.ts finds nothing to load - that is the dev/prod mechanism itself, not a runtime flag. `include` drops the base tsconfig's wholesale "Libraries" root: that pattern treats every file under the FancyLib submodule (its own tests included) as an entry point regardless of whether anything imports it, which is how FancyLib's dev-only Open Bug domain and its tests were leaking into every build before this file existed. Dropping it here relies on tsc's normal transitive dependency resolution instead - Source/extension.ts's two specific FancyLib imports still get compiled as dependencies, nothing else does.
